rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: a covariate-balance diagnostic with VIF and an explicit feasibility verdict precedes a DESeq2 Wald fit with ~sex + age_centered + condition, control as reference, raw counts with internal size factors, BH at 0.05 and apeglm on the condition coefficient, plus a sensible model-sensitivity arm. QC covers library sizes, PCA coloured by condition/sex/age and a clustering outlier policy, but omits the XIST/Y-linked sex check. Enrichment was not asked for and is arguably unwarranted; it is nonetheless well specified (full ranking with stated metric, tested-gene universe, hallmark/GO BP, 15–500 size window) though no collection version is named. Reporting is thorough on design, thresholds, tested/significant counts and power caveats, but does not explicitly require software versions in the output.
